UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.3825# 
ANSWERED ON 03.04.2025 
 
CHALLENGES FACED BY UTTAR PRADESH TOURISM INDUSTRY 
 
3825# DR. LAXMIKANT BAJPAYEE: 
 
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the various challenges faced by the tourism industry in Uttar Pradesh (UP) that are 
hampering the full potential of the State's rich heritage and cultural attractions, the details of 
the challenges on the basis of the factors responsible; 
(b) the various schemes and policies of Government through which measures are being taken to 
improve these areas and the details of achievements in the last five years, particularly in 
relation to major attractions; and 
(c) the amount allocated and spent in UP for this purpose in the l ast five years, year -wise and 
district-wise? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM                    (SHRI GAJENDRA SINGH SHEKHAWAT) 
 
(a) to (c): Development and promotion of tourist destinations and products, is undertaken by 
the respective State Government/UT Administration. The Ministry of Tourism complements the 
efforts of States/UTs by developing and promoting various tourism products of the country, 
including in Uttar Pradesh through various schemes and initiatives. To enhance the experience of 
the tourists, Ministry of Tourism has taken the following initiatives:- 
• To enhance tourism infrastructure in the country, the Ministry of Tourism through its central 
sector schemes of ‘Swadesh Darshan (SD)’, ‘Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, 
Heritage Augmentation Drive (PRASHAD)’ and ‘Assistance to Central Agencies for 
Tourism Infrastructure Development’ extends financial assistance to the State 
Governments/UT Administrations/Central Agencies including the State of Uttar Pradesh.  
• The Ministry of Tourism has now revamped the Swadesh Darshan Scheme as Swadesh 
Darshan 2.0 (SD 2.0) with the objective to develop sustainable and responsible tourism 
destinations, following a destination & tourism centric approach.  
• Government of India under the Scheme for Special Assistance to States for Capital 
Investment (SASCI Scheme) - Development of Iconic Tourist Centers to Global Scale has 
sanctioned two projects in Uttar Pradesh. 
• Ministry of Tourism has been continuously taking up the matter with all the State 
Governments/Union Territory (UT) Administrations for setting up of dedicated Tourism 
Police. The State Governments of Uttar Pradesh have deployed tourist police, in one form 
or the other. 
• The Ministry of Tourism has formulated a National Strategy for Sustainable Tourism and 
initiated Travel for LiFE programme to promote sustainable tourism in the country and to 
encourage the tourists and tourism businesses to adopt sustainable tourism practices.  
404

• Ministry is conducting Programmes under the ‘Capacity Building for Service Providers’ 
(CBSP) Scheme to train and upgrade manpower to provide better service standards. 
• To enhance the overall experience of tourists by making available a pool of local, trained 
professionals at tourist sites across the country, Ministry launched the Incredible India 
Tourist Facilitator (IITF) Certification Programme – a Pan-India online learning program.  
• The Ministry of Tourism undertakes several promotional activities in potential international 
& domestic markets to promote various tourism destinations and products of the country in 
holistic manner. This includes release of media campaigns, social media promotions, 
webinars, participation & support to promotional events, dissemination of information and 
engagement through website etc. In addition, Indian Missions overseas also undertake 
various promotional activities to attract more global travelers to various tourist destinations 
of the country. 
• The Ministry of Tourism has set up a 24x7 Multi -Lingual Tourist Info -Helpline for 
domestic and foreign tourists to provide support service in term of information relating to 
Travel in India and to offer appropriate guidance to tourists in distress while travelling in 
India. 
 
Details of funds sanctioned for the State of Uttar Pradesh under SD, SD 2.0, PRASHAD, 
Assistance to Central Agencies for Tourism Infrastructure Development’ and SASCI Schemes is 
Annexed.

(b) the details of work done under Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage  Augmentation

(c) whether Government has plan to support the tourism potential in Nanded Maharashtra; and

efforts of States/UTs by developing and promoting various tourism products of the country, including

STADIUM IN TRIBAL AREAS OF JHARKHAND 
 
3833 #.    SHRI PRADIP KUMAR VARMA: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state :- 
  
(a) whether due to absence of adequate sports stadiums and lack of facilities in the tribal dominated 
areas of Jharkhand the players get inadequate opportunity for daily practice due to which the 
development of sports talent is hindered; 
 
(b) whether there has been a persistent demand from public representatives over the years for 
setting up open stadiums in the headquarters of tribal-dominated districts across Jharkhand; and 
 
(c) if so, the details of the demands and the steps taken in this regard? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS  
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) to (c) ‘Sports’ being a State subject, the responsibility of development of sports, including setting up 
open stadiums in the country , rests primarily with the respective State/Union Territory Governments. The 
Union Government only supplements their efforts by bridging critical gaps. However, the Khelo India 
Scheme and National Sports Development Fund (NSDF), implemented by this Ministry, under 
which financial assistance for development of sports infrastructure, including sports stadia, is 
provided, are demand-driven schemes. The proposals received from the State/UT Governments and 
other eligible entities are considered for financial support, subject to their completeness, technical 
feasibility and availability of funds under the Scheme . No such proposal to set up open stadiums in 
the headquarters of tribal -dominated districts across Jharkhand  is pending in the Ministry. The 
details of the sports infrastructure projects approved and their sanctioned cost, funds released and 
their physical and financial progress, under Khelo India Scheme and NSDF, across the country, 
including in the State of Jharkhand, are available in public domain on the dashboards of the 
Ministry at https://mdsd.kheloindia.gov.in and http://www.nsdf.yas.gov.in/nsdf -glance.html. 
Further, the details of Khelo India Centres (KICs) notified and sports academies accredited under 
the Khelo India Scheme, across the country, including  in the State of Jharkhand, are available in 
public domain on the dashboard of the Ministry at https://dashboard.kheloindia.gov.in/state -wise-
khelo-india-centers.

3836.    SHRI KUNWAR RATANJEET PRATAP NARAYAN SINGH: 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state :- 
  
(a) the key objectives and goals of the Khelo India scheme, and how it has evolved over the years; 
 
(b) the amount of funds allocated for the implementation of the Khelo India scheme from  2021-
2024, and the major areas of focus for the upcoming years; 
 
(c) the number of new sports infrastructure projects that have been approved under the  scheme and 
the total sanctioned cost of these projects; and 
 
(d) the steps being taken to ensure the effective utilization of the Khelo India Centres  (KICs) for 
training children and supporting former athletes particularly in Kushinagar district? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS  
 
(DR. MANSUKH MANDAVIYA) 
 
(a) and (b) The Khelo India Scheme aims to promote mass participation and excellence in sports 
across the country , focusing on grassroots development and talent nurturing. Initially centred on 
school-level sports, it has expanded to include youth, university, winter games, and para -sports, 
with a strong emphasis on inclusivity. The scheme has been streamlined, consolidating 12 verticals 
into 5 components viz. creation and upgrading of sports infrastructure, sports competitions and 
talent development, Khelo India Centres and sports academies, the Fit India Movement, and the 
promotion of inclusiveness through sports. Key achievements under the Scheme include approval of 
321 new sports infrastructure projects, notification of 1045 Khelo India Centres (KICs) , 34 Khelo 
India State Centres of Excellence (KISCEs), accreditation of 306 sports academies aimed at training 
children, supporting former athletes, and enhancing grassroots sports infrastructure.  So far, 1 7 
editions of the Khelo India Games have been conducted, with participation from over 50,000 
athletes. The scheme has identified and supported 2 845 Khelo India Athletes (KIAs)  across the 
country who are provided with  coaching, equipment, medical care, and a monthly Out of Pocket 
Allowance (OPA) of Rs. 10,000.

are as under:

especially female students during the last five years; 
(b)  the steps taken by Government to promote science and technology amongst students of

(c)   the details of scholarships, stipends, and other allocations to students of Punjab during 
last five years; and 
(d)   the details of outcomes achieved towards this till date?

MINISTER OF STATE (INDEPENDENT CHARGE) FOR THE  
MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY & EARTH SCIENCES 
(DR. JITENDRA SINGH)  
(a) to (b): The Ministry of Science and Technology (MoST ), Government of India, has 
taken numerous steps to popularize science amongst students, including female students in 
schools and colleges across the country including Punjab, through its three verticals i) 
Department of Science and Technology (DST), ii) D epartment of Biotechnology (DBT), and 
iii) Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR). 
DST is popularizing science, technology, and innovation (STI) among school students in the 
age group of 10 -17 years to inculcate scientific temper and intro duce them to methods of 
research and innovation through its flagship programs, viz., National Children Science 
Congress (NCSC), Initiative for Research and Innovation in STEM (IRIS), and Innovation in 
Science Pursuit for Inspired Research (INSPIRE) -Million Minds Augmenting National 
Aspirations and Knowledge (MANAK). These programs are org anized at district, state, and 
national level and have benefitted more than 50 lakh students in last five years. 
In order to enhance the representation of girls in different streams of STEM (Science 
Technology Engineering Mathematics), DST initiated a dedicated program called Vigyan Jyoti 
in 2019-20, to facilitate a conducive and enabling environment for girls to pursue education in 
STEM fields. Since its inception, Vigyan Jyoti has reached out to 300 districts, benefitting more 
than 82,000 female students of class XI-XII with the assistance of one-year scholarship. 
Since 2017, Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) under the aegis of DSIR in 
collaboration with Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) has connected school students with 
CSIR-scientists to promote scientific temper under its outreach program “ Jigyasa”. The 
initiative extends classroom-based learning to research lab-based learning and has reached out 
to 9,50,000 students and 29,500 teachers.

बायत सयकाय

राज्य सभा  
अताराांकित प्रश्न सांख्या-3683 
उत्तय ददनाांक 03/04/2025 को ददमा गमा  
 
आांध्र प्रदेश ि े िोव्वाडा में परमाणु ररएक्टर िा ननमााण 
 
3683.  श्री मेयाभ िेंक ट स ुब्फा येड्डी 
 
क्मा प्रध ान भांत्री मह फतान े क ी क ृऩा क येंगे कक  :-  
 
(क ) आांध्र प्रदेश के क ोव्िाडा भें ऩयभाण ु रयएक्टय क े ननभााण की प्रगनत का ब्मौया क्मा है;  
 
(ख) क्मा उक्त ऩयभाण ु रयएक्टय का ननभााण कयने िारी कांऩनी , िेस्टांगहाउस इरेसक्िक द्िाया 
दद िालर मेऩन  क ी घोषण ा स े प्रगनत प्रब ावित हुई है, मदद हाां, तो तत्सांफांधी ब्मौया क्मा है; औय 
 
(ग) एक कनाडाई कांऩनी द्िाया िेस्टांगहाउस इरेसक्िक का अधधग्रहण ककए र्ाने से ऩरयमोर्ना को आगे 
फढ़ाने भें ककस प्रकाय भदद लभरेगी ?  
         
उत्तर 
 
याज्म भांत्री, कालभाक , रोक लशकामत औय ऩेंशन तथा प्रधानभांत्री कामाारम (डॉ. सर्तेंद्र लसांह) 
 
(क )   आांध्र प्रदेश भें कोव्िाडा ्थर ऩय, ऩरयमोर्ना औय ऩुन िाास  एिां ऩुन ्थााऩन  (आय एांड आय) 
कॉरोनी  के  लरए  ब ूलभ अधधग्रदहत की  र्ा चुक ी है। ब ूलभ के लर ए भुआिर्े के स ाथ-साथ ऩुन िाास  
एिां ऩुन ्थााऩन  नकद राब (आयएपसीटीएरएआयआय -अधधननमभ  2013 के  अन ुस ाय) याज्म 
प्राधधकारयमों क े भाध्मभ से वितरयत ककए गए है। ऩुन िाास  एिां ऩुन ्थााऩन  कॉरोनी  भें विलबन्न  
स ुविध ाओां की व्मि्था याज्म अधधकारयमों के  साथ  की र्ा यही है । 
 
(ख) िषा 2017 भें भेससा  डब््मूईस ी द्िाया ददिालरमाऩन  की  घोषणा  से , िषा 2016 भें उनक े  द्िाया ददए  
गए तकनीकी -िाणणसज्मक प्र्ताि (टीसीओ ) ऩय चचाा की  प्रगनत प्रब ावित हुई, सर्ससे एक व्म िहामा 
ऩरयमोर्ना प्र्ताि ऩय सहभनत फनाना कदिन हो गमा । 
 
(ग)  
 
िषा 2018 भें ददिालरमे ऩन  से  उफयने  औय भेससा  ब्रुक पी्ड बफर्नेस  ऩाटानसा , कनाडा  द्िाया

में द्वव र्ीयक और र्ृर्ीयक देखिाल अस्पर्ाल में िर्ी होने के भलए प्रतर् व षत प्रत्येक पात्र लािार्थी 
पररवार को 5 लाख रुपये र्क की तनिः शुल्क स्व ास््य सेव ा प्रदान करर्ा है। समय-समय पर

करना, नए अस्पर्ालों को सूिीबद्ध करना, नए लािाचर्थतयों को शाभमल करना और अन्य सुधार क्रकए 
जार्े हैं। एबी-पीएमजेएवाई को लागू करने व ाले कई राज्यों और संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों (यूटी) ने गैर -
एसईसीसी डेटा स्रोर्ों (राष्ट्र ीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अचधतनयम, राज्य वव भशष्ट्ट डेटासेट सहहर्) का उपयोग 
करके योजना के र्हर् अपने स्वयं के खित पर लािार्थी आधार का और ववस्र्ार क्रकया है।

एसएटीटीई 2025 में गोवा पययटन द्वारा किए गए सहयोग/समझौते 
 
3821  डा. भागवत िराड़: 
  क्र्ा पययटन मंत्री र्ह बतान े क ी क ृपा क रेंगे कक िः 
(क ) िक्षिण एलशर्ा का र्ात्रा और पर्यटन एक्सजेंज (एसएटीटीई) 2025 में गोवा पर्यटन द्वारा 
सतत एव ं पुन र्ोजी पर्यटन  क ो बढाव ा िेन े के लल ए क्र्ा प्रमुि पहल  क ी गई है;  
(ि) क्र्ा इस आर्ोजन में अंतरायष्ट्रीर् पर्यटन ननकार्ों र्ा दहतधारकों के साथ कोई सहर्ोग र्ा 
समझौते पर हस्तािर ककए जा रहे हैं ;  
(ग) र्दि हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्र्ौरा क्र्ा है;  
(घ) क्र्ा सरकार गोवा में हररत पर्यटन अवसंरचना में ननजी िेत्र के ननवेश को प्रोत्सादहत करने 
के ललए कोई ववत्तीर् र्ा नीनतगत प्रोत्साहन प्रिान कर रही है; और  
(ङ) र्दि हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्र्ौरा क्र्ा है? 
 
उत्तर 
पययटन मंत्री      (श्री गजेन्द्र ससंह शेखावत) 
  
(क) से (ङ) : गोवा सदहत सभी राज्र् और संघ राज्र्िेत्र अपनी-अपनी पर्यटन नीनतर्ों और 
क ार्यन ीनतर्ों के अन ुरू प अपन े पर्यटन  उत्पािों क ा स्व तंत्र रू प से संव धयन  और ववपणन करते हैं। गोवा 
पर्यटन  न े सूचच त कक र्ा है कक  उन्होंन े िक्षिण एलशर्ा के र्ात्रा और पर्यटन  एक्सच ेंज (एसएटीटीई) 
2025 में भाग ललर्ा, जहां उसने राज्र् की ववववध पर्यटन पेशकशों, जैसे सांस्क ृनतक  वव रासत, इको -
पर्यटन पहल , साहलसक पर्यटन , महोत्सवों और तटों से हटकर इमलसयव एक्सपीररर्ंस को प्रिलशयत 
ककर्ा। कार्यक्रम के िौरान, राज्र् ने सहर्ोग के अवसरों का पता लगार्ा , मीडिर्ा प्रनतननचधर्ों से 
बातचीत की  एव ं गोव ा में स्थार्ी और पुन र्ोजी पर्यटन  प्रोत्सादहत करने के ललए पर्यटन दहतधारकों 
और सरकारी अचधकाररर्ों के साथ परस्पर व्र्वसानर्क बैठक ें (बी-टू-बी) कीं।  
 
राज्र् न े सूचच त कक र्ा है कक  उन्होंन े आर्ोजन  के िौरान  ककसी  भी समझौते पर हस्तािर नहीं ककए 
हैं।  
 
पर्यटन मंत्रालर् ने स्थार्ी पर्यटन के ललए एक राष्ट्रीर् कार्यनीनत तैर्ार की है और िेश भर में 
स्थार्ी पर्यटन को बढावा िेने के ललए रैवल फॉर लाइफ का र्यक्रम शुरू  कक र्ा है, जो गोवा सदहत 
पर्यटकों एवं पर्यटन व्र्वसार्ों िोनों को प्रोत्सादहत करता है, ताकक स्थार्ी प्रथाओं को अपनार्ा जा 
सके।

क े  प्रर्ासों क ो संपूरर त  क र त ा है। 
 
पर्यटन मंत्रालर्, ‘स्विेश िशयन (एसडी)’, जजसे अब स्विेश िशयन 2.0 (एसडी 2.0) क े  नाम से

3824 श्री शुभाशीष खुंटट या:

और 
(घ) पर्यटन अव संरचना में सुध ार के लल ए ओडिशा सरक ार के साि सहर्ोग क रने क ी मंत्राल र् क ी 
क्र्ा र्ोजनाएं हैं? 
 
उत्तर 
पययटन मंत्री      (श्री गजेन्द्र ससंह शेखावत) 
 
(क) से (घ) : पर्यटन थिलों और उत्पािों का ववकास और संवधयन संबंधधत राज्र् सरकार /संघ 
राज्र्क्षेत्र प्रशासन द्वारा ककर्ा जाता है। पर्यटन मंत्रालर् ‘थविेश िशयन (एसिी) ’ और ‘तीियथिल 
जीर्णोद्धार एवं  आध्र्ास्त्मक, ववरासत संवधयन अलभर्ान (प्रशाि) ’ नामक अपनी क ें द्रीर् क्षेत्र की 
र्ोजनाओं के माध्र्म से ओडिशा राज्र् सदहत राज्र् सरकारों/संघ राज्र्क्षेत्र प्रशासनों को ववत्तीर् 
सहार्त ा प्रिान क रके िेश में पर्यटन अव संरचना के वव क ास के प्रर्ासों क ो संपूररत करता  है। 
 
र्ोजना के दिशा-तनिेशों में पर्यटन थिलों पर अन्र् बातों के साि-साि पर्यटक  सुवव ध ा कें द्र, पर्यटक 
सूचना कें द्र, लॉग हट्स, एम्फीधिएटर, फुट-ओवर ब्रिज, साइनेज, सीसीटीवी , अंततम छोर तक सड़क 
संपकय , अग्रभाग की प्रकाश व्र्वथिा, मूल भूत  सुवव ध ाएं जैसे शौचाल र्, कूड़ेिान, पेर्जल  सुवव ध ाएं, 
जल  तनक ासी और अपलशष्ट प्रबंध न सुवव ध ाएं और अन्र् थिल ववकास कार्य जैसे बेंच , भू-दृश्र् 
तनमायर्ण, फलोररंग , रेललंग आदि के ववकास का प्रावधा न ककर्ा गर्ा है। 
 
इसके अलावा , पर्यटन मंत्राल र् पर्यटन थिल ों से जुड़े मागों और वव मान-र्ात्रा संपकय में सुध ार के 
ललए सड़क पररवहन मंत्रालर् और नागररक उड्िर्न मंत्रालर् के साि लमलकर काम करता है।
